body:
Me n my buddys decide to pickup some 10x from a smoke shop, we grabbed 4 grams. The first time I do it I smoke a bowl, about three hits, I get a little stoned and watch in awe as my buddys nearly bust a lung laughing... Next day I try it again and all I do is get irritated cuz everyone else is trippen n being stupid I do it again, 4 bowls in a row this time, and I still get nothing more than a drunk feeling as I watch my friends halucinate and trip out off of half the dose.  I read so many reviews about tripping balls I'm a little disapointed, oh well, off to bigger and better
